summary: BJØDNÅSDALEN AS (org. no. 999 539 513) is a private limited company (AS) based in Strand, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2013-01-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.120 (Utvikling og salg av byggeprosjekter); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 177 178. CEO: Magnar Ur; board chair: Magnar Ur.
